subject: Fitting multivariate Spatio-temporal Model in R-INLA

messages.author: 14ee5df6121f437e
messages.subject: Fitting multivariate Spatio-temporal Model in R-INLA
parts:
Hi all,

I just wanted an example of fitting multivariate Spatio-temporal model using R-INLA. For example, the response variables could be incidence of 3 types of cancer over several areas(say 2000 areas) and two time points(2 years). Now I want to fit a multivariate model without covariates. Is there any example of this type?

Thanks.
Farzana.

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fitting multivariate Spatio-temporal Model in R-INLA
parts:
I think any example of "multiple likelihoods" should be helpful. There are some in the SPDE tutorial. Although examples often use different likelihood family-s, you may want to use the same family.

Regards,
Haakon
